source: Simplified from: AIDSII: An AI-based digital system for intelligent irrigation, Software Impacts, 2023
title: AIDSII: an AI-based digital system for intelligent irrigation
abstract: Farmers face a shortage of water and fertile land while the demand for food keeps rising. We introduce AIDSII, an app that combines IoT sensors in the field with deep learning models (CNN-LSTM) to decide when and how much to irrigate. Farmers automate their irrigation from their phone, which reduces water waste and improves yields.

source: Simplified from: Can Bitcoin mining increase renewable electricity capacity?, Resource and Energy Economics, 2023
title: Can Bitcoin mining increase renewable electricity capacity?
abstract: Supporters of Bitcoin claim that miners' demand for electricity leads to more renewable capacity. We estimate a Bitcoin electricity demand curve and add it to a long-run model of the Texas electricity market. Bitcoin mining does increase renewable capacity, but it also increases carbon emissions. When miners offer demand response to the grid, most of the extra emissions disappear.
